source_files_inspected: blastradius/backend/api_server.py (route list, ingest, github/pr, pr/triage fallbacks)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Python AST code-graph ingestion (functions, classes, calls, API routes)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real ast.parse over **/*.py producing Function/Class/API_Endpoint nodes and CALLS/ROUTES_TO edges with one MERGE per row (no UNWIND batching). Calls are resolved by bare callee name against functions already seen, so cross-file calls to files parsed later are missed and same-named functions are conflated; Python only.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Blast radius upstream-caller query with ADR and API perimeter
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cypher uses (caller)-[:CALLS*1..$hops]->(target) with the bound passed as a query parameter; parameterized variable-length bounds are not generally supported by openCypher engines, so this must be tested on FalkorDB 4.22 (likely to error and fall into the demo fallback).

implemented_capabilities.capability: FalkorDB native graph algorithm tools (PageRank, Betweenness, SPpaths, WCC, label propagation)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Thin wrappers over algo.pageRank, algo.betweenness, algo.SPpaths, algo.WCC, algo.labelPropagation that persist scores onto nodes. Neo4j-GDS-free but FalkorDB-version dependent; unverified here. Writes run through g.query from tools exposed to the LLM.
Uses db.idx.vector.queryNodes and db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes plus 2-hop traversal; caller must supply the embedding vector. Schema bootstrap swallows all index errors.

memory_lookup reads AgentEpisode NEXT chains seeded by seed_demo.py (AgentEpisode nodes are only created by seeds/seed_demo.py:~414; no runtime code writes new episodes); clone_pr_sandbox issues GRAPH.COPY to {base}_pr_{pr_id} and returns status 'simulated' when the DB is offline.

When the graph query returns no rows the endpoint substitutes hard-coded caller/API/ADR/CVE lists keyed on substrings of the function id (e.g. 'payment', 'jwt'); fetch_github_pr returns a fabricated '[Demo]' PR when GitHub is unreachable; /api/ingest returns invented stats (48 functions, 72 calls) on error with status demo_fallback; /api/graph/nodes has a hard-coded fallback graph. Results can look real while being canned.
Streams litellm.acompletion with the MCP tool set; if litellm or the key is missing it falls back to keyword intent detection and calls a tool directly (call_id 'call_fallback_1').

graph_models_and_cypher: FalkorDB graph 'blastradius'. Labels: Function{id,name,module,filePath,pagerank_score,betweenness_score,community_id,wcc_id,embedding}, Class, API_Endpoint{route,method,is_public}, Package, CVE{cve_id,cvss}, Developer, Commit, PullRequest, PastIncident, ProceduralPlaybook, ArchitectureDoc, AgentEpisode, Service. Edges: CALLS{weight}, ROUTES_TO, USES_PACKAGE, HAS_VULNERABILITY, AUTHORED, MODIFIED{lines_changed,invalidated_at}, GOVERNS, OWNS, CONTAINS, CAUSED_BY, INVESTIGATED, REMEDIATES, NEXT. FalkorDB-specific procedures: algo.pageRank, algo.betweenness, algo.SPpaths, algo.WCC, algo.labelPropagation, db.idx.vector.createNodeIndex/queryNodes, db.idx.fulltext.*, GRAPH.COPY, GRAPH.EXPLAIN. Cypher values are bound params, but graph_schema.py builds fulltext index calls by f-string from literal lists.
algorithms: Reverse CALLS traversal with hop cap as blast radius (mcp_server.py:blast_radius; bound-parameter range unverified)
PageRank + betweenness centrality persisted on nodes (mcp_server.py:compute_centrality)
Weighted shortest exploit path from public endpoint to vulnerable package via algo.SPpaths (mcp_server.py:cve_exploit_chain)
backend_interfaces: FastMCP server (mcp_server.py): blast_radius, compute_centrality, cve_exploit_chain, detect_communities, get_ownership, hybrid_search, memory_lookup, clone_pr_sandbox, graph_stats
frontend_interfaces: Next.js 15 pages: agent, algorithms (SqlVsGraphBenchmark), blast-radius (BlastShockwaveSimulator), company-brain, cve, graph, memory, pr-agent; JudgeTourModal; VectorVsGraphDiff; lib/falkordb.ts
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Episodic memory modeled as AgentEpisode nodes chained by NEXT and linked INVESTIGATED->Function, plus ProceduralPlaybook REMEDIATES->Function, read by memory_lookup/hybrid_search; Triage->Remediation handoff is described in docs but implemented mainly in the demo triage endpoint. Ownership query filters MODIFIED edges by invalidated_at IS NULL (a temporal-invalidation hook) but nothing in the reviewed code writes invalidated_at.
tests_present: None: scripts/test_mcp.py is a manual smoke script with no test_ functions; no pytest suite and no frontend tests.
security_findings: blastradius/backend/api_server.py:~84-85 - CORS allow_origins includes '*' alongside the localhost origins; no authentication on any route

blastradius/backend/api_server.py:~265-273 - POST /api/tool/run dispatches any named tool with arbitrary args, including write tools (compute_centrality, detect_communities, clone_pr_sandbox) and a user-chosen graph name

blastradius/backend/api_server.py:~299-312 - POST /api/ingest takes a caller-supplied repo_path and walks/parses every .py under it (arbitrary local path read, path traversal); errors return fabricated stats
blastradius/backend/api_server.py:~321-340 - /api/github/pr issues outbound GitHub API requests for user-supplied repo/pr_number with optional GITHUB_TOKEN; falls back to fabricated demo PR data
blastradius/backend/graph_schema.py:~65-71 - f-string Cypher for fulltext index creation built from literal label/property lists (not user-controlled)
blastradius/backend/mcp_server.py:349-363 - clone_pr_sandbox builds graph name from unvalidated pr_id/base_graph and calls raw GRAPH.COPY (graph-name injection / overwrite of arbitrary graph copies)
No real secrets found; .env.example has placeholder OPENAI_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY entries
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps Software Dependency Intelligence and blast-radius traversal (AgentAhmed/blast-radius, 986036734/blastradius, NishaadG/blastradius, sevenhiremath/blastradius); the CVE exploit-chain tool overlaps Security & Vulnerability attack-path repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - ADR GOVERNS edges, AgentEpisode NEXT chains and an invalidated_at edge filter hint at provenance and temporal validity, but nothing writes invalidation, there is no supersession or approval gating, and many outputs are canned fallbacks.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Compact catalogue of FalkorDB-native algo.* and index procedure calls (PageRank, betweenness, SPpaths, WCC, labelPropagation, vector, fulltext) with persisted scores - useful as a syntax/reference sheet to verify against FalkorDB 4.22.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB with algo.* procedures, vector and fulltext indexes; LiteLLM/OpenAI key only for the agent

strategy_rationale: Several headline results are produced by hard-coded fallback data, the blast-radius Cypher uses a questionable parameterized range, the API is unauthenticated with broad write and path-read surfaces, and there is no license; only the algorithm call syntax and the name-based AST ingest idea are worth referencing.
